company.shortDescription: Bloom is an online apparel e-commerce platform that offers customers to try clothes before buying them.
company.description: Bloom is a platform that sell original brand outlets from curated lists of international brands. Bloom allows customers to try on the clothes they have ordered online in the comfort of their own homes before having to pay for them, while also offering the option of easily returning the items they do not like with a click of a button.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,239,137 to $1,911,325, a 1.54x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 38 (+6 over 90 days) and market heat at 74 (+4).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
